findings.requirement: Plating thickness is allowed for on tight fits and threads
findings.comment: Dimension D18 specifies an ISO fit (H7) on a part that is plated/coated (IZBP per Note N4). The drawing does not indicate that the plating thickness has been allowed for in the tolerance or size, nor does it specify masking or post-plating machining for this feature. This risks the hole becoming undersized after coating, preventing assembly.
findings.recommended_correction: Specify masking for the H7 hole during plating, or adjust the pre-plate dimension/tolerance to account for the IZBP coating thickness.
